name: War-Awoken Throttle Waterfall (Weapon Skill)
effects:
Single-target Water/NE piercing physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & 30% DEF/RES Pierce to Water Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if the user has Lv.0/3 Attach Water
WS Blue: [Attach Water 3 with Stacking] to the user
WS Gold: During Tactical Awoken Mode, Water Ability Damage +50%, Quick Water & 250 SB Points to the user
